title: Berkeley Annual General Adjustment for 2026 (Regulation 1148)
requirement: Eligible landlords under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026, subject to the conditions and tenant notice in Rent Board Regulation 1148.
coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units with 2025 permanent rent ceilings; the increase may not be applied to tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

applicability.per_tenancy: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
coverage_quotes: The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
interaction: Excludes tenancies whose rents were set under the state Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
